protocol: annual aligned T=1/3/5 targets; T=3 context; joint T=5+target footprint

empty_policy: Dice/IoU empty-empty=1; precision undefined without predicted positives; recall/AP undefined without target positives; null excluded from macro with defined count
average_precision: exact two-score tied AP; not trapezoidal PR area
validity: NaN fire=no detection; explicit GDAL/alpha masks and finite nodata invalid; intersect target and all 5 context footprints
selection: all official 2020 aligned windows, no label sampling
